about_the_game:
Important: Tape Us Out is a fully online cooperative experience. To play, two players are required, each with their own copy of the game and a means of communication with each other.

Narrative

It all begins when two friends, passionate about antiques, stumble upon a garage sale. Curious, they explore the place in search of relics until they come across a box full of VHS tapes. Among familiar and worn-out titles, one tape stands out: Tape Us Out — a name neither of them had ever heard before.

Excited, they decide to have a surprise movie session that afternoon. Little did they know that by pressing play, they were about to dive into something far beyond a simple film…

In the blink of an eye, the two are pulled into the TV.

Now trapped, they must journey through worlds inspired by different cinematic genres: from epic high-fantasy adventures, to the tension of a crime thriller where every second counts to defuse a bomb, and even the horror of being hunted by a monster.

List of Features

  • Two players, each with their own unique perspective.

  • Mandatory online cooperative experience.

  • Environments based on six films from distinct genres.

  • Immersive narrative with a nostalgic VHS-inspired aesthetic.

  • Gameplay focused on communication and coordination between players.

  • No maps, hints, or in-game tutorials — everything depends on cooperation.

Solve Together

You have no maps. No hints.

All you have is each other’s mind — and your voices.

Don’t forget: the only way out is by working together.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8.1/10 (64bit)
  • Processor: 2 Cores @ 2.3Ghz
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel(R) HD Graphics 520
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8.1/10 (64bit)
  • Processor: 4 Cores @ 3Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 980 and above
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 800 MB available space

short_description: Tape Us Out is an asymmetric, online co-op puzzle game. Players are sucked into a VHS tape and must face challenges of logic, coordination, and communication within the universe of old movies to find their way back to reality.
